# skycloak_realm_group_membership (Resource)

Adds a user to a realm group. One resource per (user, group) edge.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skycloak_realm_group_membership" "jdoe_eng" {
  cluster_id = skycloak_cluster.production.id
  realm_name = skycloak_realm.app.name
  user_id    = skycloak_realm_user.jdoe.id
  group_id   = skycloak_realm_group.engineering.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID. Immutable.
- `group_id` (String) Group ID. Immutable.
- `realm_name` (String) Realm name. Immutable.
- `user_id` (String) User ID. Immutable.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
